description: This PHP script handles WPS configuration actions such as enabling/disabling WPS, setting WPS methods, pairing clients via push button or PIN, and canceling sessions. It processes POST data, performs validation, and interacts with device configuration via setStr calls.

methods.name: validChecksum
methods.description: Validates the checksum of a WPS PIN, supporting 4 and 8 digit formats.

methods.name: MiniApplySSID
methods.description: Applies settings to a specific SSID by setting appropriate device parameters.
